idea.name: Funding carry (delta-neutral)
idea.blurb: Hyperliquid perps vs spot · collects funding · market-neutral
idea.source: Schmeling, Schrimpf & Todorov, 'Crypto Carry' (BIS WP 1087 / Management Science); Hyperliquid funding docs
idea.rule: Daily at 00:00 UTC: for coins whose 7-day average funding is above 15% a year (up to 6, richest first), buy spot and short the same amount of perp; keep while funding stays above 5%. Price moves cancel, the book earns the funding longs pay shorts.

backtest.caveat: Sharpe is flattered by the smooth hourly premium used as the basis proxy; real risks are tail events (short-squeeze margin calls, venue risk) and a yield that has been shrinking.

idea.name: Alt/BTC cross trend (market-neutral)
idea.blurb: Altcoins priced in BTC · trend-following · BTC-hedged, beta ~0
idea.source: Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen, 'Time series momentum' (JFE 2012); Menkhoff et al., 'Currency momentum strategies' (JFE 2012); Liu & Tsyvinski, 'Risks and Returns of Cryptocurrency' (RFS 2021)
idea.rule: Daily at 00:00 UTC: for each altcoin, price it in BTC and average the trend sign over 10/20/42/84 days (-1..+1). Long the alt perp when its BTC cross trends up, short when it trends down, sized to 20% vol per cross / 21 alts; the BTC perp takes the opposite of the net alt exposure (market-neutral).

backtest.caveat: Weak edge: the direction calls beat random ones (p=0.03) but the Sharpe interval includes zero and the last two years were flat (Sharpe -0.06). On probation - it earns its place on paper or gets retired. Uses only ~36% of the book gross, so returns are small by design.

idea.name: Vol-managed crypto momentum (market-neutral)
idea.blurb: Weekly winners minus losers · sized by momentum's own recent volatility
idea.source: Grobys, Kolari, Sandretto, Shahzad & Aijo, 'Cryptocurrency momentum has (not) its moments', Financial Markets and Portfolio Management 39(4) 2025; Barroso & Santa-Clara, 'Momentum has its moments', JFE 2015
idea.rule: Mondays 00:00 UTC: rank coins by 30-day return (skip the latest day); long the top fifth, short the bottom fifth, equal weight; scale the book by 20% / its own realised vol over the last 8 weeks (max 2x).

backtest.caveat: On probation. The paper's key claim - that volatility scaling improves crypto momentum - did NOT replicate on our coins (scaled 0.51 vs unscaled 0.66). The winner/loser picks beat random ones only weakly (p=0.07), the Sharpe interval includes zero, and it lost money in 2025 and 2026. Backtest drawdown 42.5% would have tripped this book's 30% kill switch in 2025.

scene.title: Crypto momentum, week by week
scene.glow_label: size of the momentum book's position (long winners / short losers)

idea.name: Breakout Rocket: Donchian breakout ensemble (leveraged)
idea.blurb: Nine channel breakouts per coin · trailing stops · 80% vol target, up to 4x
idea.source: Zarattini, Pagani & Barbon, 'Catching Crypto Trends; A Tactical Approach for Bitcoin and Altcoins', SSRN 5209907 (2025): Donchian ensemble over nine horizons, BTC net Sharpe 1.56, CAGR 30%, max DD 19% at a 25% vol target; top-20 rotation ~11%/yr alpha over BTC
idea.rule: Daily 00:00 UTC: for each coin run nine breakout systems (5-360 days): long on a close above the prior L-day high, out on a close below the trailing channel midpoint. Signal = share of systems long; size by 1/60-day vol; scale the book to 80%/yr vol, max 4x gross.

backtest.caveat: Max risk by design: at this setting the backtest fell 82.5% peak-to-trough and lost 24.5% over the last 12 months (BTC -28.5%); returns stop growing above ~80-100% vol, so this is the top of the dial, not a step on the way up. The kill switch fires at -85%. Coins are today's Hyperliquid survivors, which flatters a long-only result. 0.83 correlated with Strategy 1. The long/short version did NOT replicate (Sharpe 0.78, short leg -12%/yr), so it is long-only.

idea.name: 52-week-high momentum (market-neutral)
idea.blurb: Long the coins pinned near their yearly high · short the ones far below it
idea.source: George & Hwang, 'The 52-Week High and Momentum Investing', Journal of Finance 59(5) 2004; Ficura, 'Impact of size and volume on cryptocurrency momentum and reversal', Prague University of Economics and Business WP 2023/5
idea.rule: Mondays 00:00 UTC: PTH = last close / 52-week high for coins with a full year of data; long the top 30% by PTH, short the bottom 30%, equal weight, 0.5x equity per side.

backtest.caveat: Picks beat random coin picks (p=0.02) and ranking by the 52-week high beats ranking by the 52-week return (-0.13), as the paper predicts, and it hedges Strategy 1 (corr -0.42). But the Sharpe interval includes zero, the walk-forward that re-picks the lookback each quarter made only 0.22, it leans short the market (corr -0.51 with the equal-weight basket), and funding before Oct 2024 is missing from the history.

idea.name: Winners vs Bitcoin (alt momentum, BTC-hedged)
idea.blurb: Buys the strongest alts · shorts only Bitcoin as the hedge · an alt-season catcher (probation)
idea.source: Fieberg, Liedtke & Zaremba, 'Cryptocurrency anomalies and economic constraints', International Review of Financial Analysis 94 (2024); Grobys, Kolari, Sandretto, Shahzad & Aijo, 'Cryptocurrency momentum has (not) its moments', Financial Markets and Portfolio Management 39(4) 2025
idea.rule: Mondays 00:00 UTC: buy the 30% of altcoins with the best 28-day return (equal weight, 1x equity) and short BTC perp for their combined 90-day beta to BTC. Never shorts an altcoin.

backtest.risk_dial: 1x live; 1.5x is the top of the growth curve (42.5%/yr) but max DD 80%
backtest.caveat: Probation, and the numbers say why: the whole edge is the 2021 alt season (+1,269%). Without 2021 the Sharpe is -0.02, the walk-forward made 0.13, and random alt picks with the same BTC hedge already score 0.47 (p=0.057 vs placebo). It is on paper as a cheap, market-neutral-on-paper 'alt-season option' that diversifies Strategy 8 (corr -0.27): it bleeds slowly while Bitcoin leads and pays off big when alts run. The BTC hedge does not remove alt-crash risk (60.7% max DD).

idea.name: Coin Rider: one Solana/Base coin, ridden hourly
idea.blurb: Rides the one dev-vetted Solana/Base/Robinhood-chain coin breaking out hardest · checked hourly · sells when the trend breaks (probation)
idea.source: Zarattini, Pagani & Barbon, 'Catching Crypto Trends; A Tactical Approach for Bitcoin and Altcoins' (SSRN 5209907, 2025); Bui & Nguyen, 'Systematic Trend-Following with Adaptive Portfolio Construction' (arXiv 2602.11708, 2026); Liu, Tsyvinski & Wu, 'Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency', Journal of Finance 77(2) 2022; dev screen per Trockman, van Tonder & Vasilescu (MSR 2019): developer activity is a safety filter, not a return signal
idea.rule: Hourly: if flat, buy (1x) the dev-vetted Solana/Base/Robinhood-chain coin that just closed at a new 7-day high with the best 28-day risk-adjusted return; ride it until it closes 3 daily vols below its peak since entry; then sell, bar it 24h and pick the next breakout.

backtest.period: Jun 2024 - Oct 2026 (4h bars); hourly test Mar - Oct 2026
backtest.risk_dial: 1x live = top of the hourly growth curve (55%/yr, DD 55%). 2x: -40%/yr hourly, -89%/yr on 4h - leverage only adds losses on a single ~115%-vol coin. 0.5x: 49%/yr hourly, DD 31%.
backtest.caveat: Probation, weak evidence. The first rule (7-day ranking, 72h-EMA exit) lost in every test and was rejected. This breakout version makes money only in the hourly test (7 months, 12 rides, all of it from one +160% PUMP ride in Jul-Aug 2026; 4 of 12 rides won) and loses 37.5%/yr on the 2.3-year 4h test with a 94% drawdown. Picking a random breakout coin does as well as picking the strongest one (placebo p=1.0), so the 'pick the best coin' part adds nothing measurable - the return is the breakout plus the chandelier exit. The developer screen beat the memecoin control (0.14 vs -0.25) but not the unscreened list (0.38), and it uses today's knowledge (look-ahead). Survivorship: only coins listed today are tested. Expect 50%+ drawdowns; kill switch at 60%.

idea.name: Breakaway Alts (coin-specific jump drift, BTC-hedged)
idea.blurb: Buys an alt the day it jumps on its own news · hedges out Bitcoin · rides the 5-day drift · 2.5x
idea.source: Liu & Tsyvinski, 'Risks and Returns of Cryptocurrency', Review of Financial Studies 34(6) 2021 (crypto underreacts: momentum and attention effects at 1-4 weeks); Caporale & Plastun, 'Momentum effects in the cryptocurrency market after one-day abnormal returns', Financial Markets and Portfolio Management 34 (2020); Grobys et al., 'Cryptocurrency momentum has (not) its moments', FMPM 39(4) 2025
idea.rule: Daily 00:00 UTC: residual = alt return - 90d beta x BTC return; if yesterday's residual > 2.5 sd of its 90-day history, hold the alt for 5 days (20% equity each, max 1x), short BTC for the beta, whole book 2.5x. Never shorts an alt.

backtest.caveat: Strong and stable for a crypto anomaly: positive every year, every threshold/hold cell (Sharpe 0.66-1.45), 3x costs and a day-late entry. But random alts bought on the same days already make Sharpe 0.71 (the days themselves are alt-friendly), so the coin choice adds about 0.5; the walk-forward made 0.87, not 1.22. At 2.5x the backtest lost 67% peak to trough and a worst day of -30% (kill switch at 75%). Pre-2023 prices partly predate Hyperliquid listings.

ideas.name: Winners vs Bitcoin (alt momentum, BTC-hedged) - Strategy 9
ideas.source: Fieberg, Liedtke & Zaremba, IRFA 94 (2024); Grobys et al., FMPM 39(4) 2025 - https://ideas.repec.org/a/eee/finana/v94y2024ics1057521924001509.html
ideas.rule: Mondays 00:00 UTC: buy the top 30% of altcoins by 28-day return (1x equity, equal weight), short BTC perp for their combined 90-day beta; never short an alt.
ideas.verdict: Live on probation: Sharpe 0.83 (CI -0.01 to 1.66), 40%/yr, max DD 60.7% Dec 2020-Sep 2026, but all of it from 2021 (+1,269%); ex-2021 Sharpe -0.02, walk-forward 0.13, placebo p=0.057; diversifies S8 (corr -0.27).

ideas.name: Single-coin rider, variant A: 7-day risk-adjusted ranking + 72h-EMA exit (Solana/Base/Robinhood-chain)
ideas.source: Liu, Tsyvinski & Wu, JF 2022 (crypto momentum); Bui & Nguyen, arXiv 2602.11708 (2026); dev screen per Trockman et al., MSR 2019 | https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11708
ideas.rule: Hourly: buy the one dev-vetted coin with the best 7-day risk-adjusted return above its 72h EMA and up on the day; exit at 2 daily vols below peak or below the EMA; 24h cooldown.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: hourly Sharpe -0.48 (-73.6%/yr) and 4h Sharpe -1.01 (DD 99%); whipsawed by hourly mean reversion even while its universe rose 75%.

ideas.name: Coin Rider: one Solana/Base coin, ridden hourly - Strategy 10
ideas.source: Zarattini, Pagani & Barbon, SSRN 5209907 (2025); Liu, Tsyvinski & Wu, JF 2022 (crypto momentum); Bui & Nguyen, arXiv 2602.11708 (2026); dev screen per Trockman et al., MSR 2019 | https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=5209907
ideas.rule: Hourly: if flat, buy (1x) the dev-vetted Solana/Base/Robinhood-chain coin at a new 7-day high with the best 28-day risk-adjusted return; ride until it closes 3 daily vols below its peak since entry; 24h cooldown.
ideas.verdict: Probation: hourly test Sharpe 0.96 (+55%/yr, DD 55%) but it is one +160% PUMP ride; 2.3-year 4h test Sharpe 0.14, -37.5%/yr, DD 94%; random breakout picks do as well (placebo p=1.0).

ideas.name: Cross-sectional short-term reversal (1-day / 1-week)
ideas.source: Bianchi, Babiak & Dickerson, J. Banking & Finance 2022, https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3239670
ideas.rule: Daily: long the 30% of coins with the worst previous-day return, short the best 30%, 0.5x per side, hold 1 day (also 7-day formation/hold).
ideas.verdict: Rejected: loses before costs (gross Sharpe -0.34), net -1.32 with 39.5%/yr costs; weekly version net -0.09 - large liquid coins continue rather than reverse.

ideas.name: Bitcoin-to-altcoin lead-lag
ideas.rule: Trade alts' BTC-residual return in the direction of the previous bar's BTC return (1h, 4h, 1d).
ideas.verdict: Rejected: correlation of lagged BTC return with alt residual -0.04 daily (2,147 days), +0.006 4h, -0.03 1h - no signal.

ideas.name: Perp premium as order-flow predictor (4h)
ideas.rule: Hyperliquid perp premium over the last 4h vs the next 4-24h return, pooled / cross-sectional / per-coin z.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: correlations 0.004-0.013 on 96k coin-bars - nothing to trade.

ideas.name: 4h crash rebound / liquidity provision (BTC-hedged)
ideas.source: Farag, Luo, Yarovaya & Zieba, J. Banking & Finance 175 (2025), https://ideas.repec.org/a/eee/jbfina/v175y2025ics0378426625000317.html
ideas.rule: Buy an alt after a -3 sd BTC-residual 4h drop (vs 30-day residual vol), short BTC for its beta, hold 24h, 20% per ticket.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: Sharpe 0.84 Jul 2024-Oct 2026 but 0.11 entered one bar late, -0.26 at 3x costs, -0.12 without its 5 best days; daily market-wide crash buying lost 82% in 2022.

ideas.name: RSI(2) pullbacks in uptrends
ideas.rule: Buy a coin above its 100/200-day SMA when 2-day RSI < 5/10/20; exit above the 5-day SMA or after 10 days; 20% per coin.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: Sharpe 0.20-0.66 across settings Mar 2021-Oct 2026, 2022 -18.6% - weak and no better than its trend filter.

ideas.name: Breakaway Alts: coin-specific jump drift, BTC-hedged (2.5x) - Strategy 11
ideas.source: Liu & Tsyvinski, Review of Financial Studies 34(6) 2021, https://academic.oup.com/rfs/article/34/6/2689/5912024; Caporale & Plastun, FMPM 34 (2020); Grobys et al., FMPM 39(4) 2025
ideas.rule: Daily 00:00 UTC: residual = alt return - 90d beta x BTC return; if yesterday's residual > 2.5 sd of its 90-day history, hold the alt 5 days (20% equity each, max 1x), short BTC for the beta, whole book 2.5x; never shorts an alt.
ideas.verdict: Live at 2.5x: Sharpe 1.22 (CI 0.44-1.93), 93.8%/yr, max DD 67.3% Dec 2020-Oct 2026 (1x: 40%/yr, DD 34%); walk-forward 0.87, placebo p=0.017, positive every year, 3x costs 0.93, day-late entry 0.90.
